summary: Reading the amnesia scroll reaches read.c:seffect_amnesia, but JavaScript only records an unported gap. C first draws rnd(3) inside read.c:forget at step 22, then chooses the Maud message and exercises wisdom. The whole source path must also update spell memory, weapon skill training, seen-monster flags, and punished ball-and-chain memory; later status or action histories can expose those effects.

source.branch: read.c:seffect_amnesia (1830-1847) sets known, calls forget with ALL_SPELLS unless blessed, chooses one of three messages under Hallucination/name/RNG conditions, and exercises wisdom. read.c:forget (1020-1043) clears punished ball-chain memory, conditionally calls losespells, draws rnd(howmuch?5:3) for drain_weapon_skill, and clears meverseen on current and migrating monsters except steed/stuck. Preserve the RNG before the Maud-message draw.
callers: read.c:seffects case SCR_AMNESIA calls seffect_amnesia(&sobj); js/read.js:seffects currently calls note_unported at that dispatch arm.
read.c:doread reaches seffects after ordinary scroll selection and consumption setup.
dependencies: spell.c:losespells and weapon.c:drain_weapon_skill are not yet implemented in JS; C discards their return values, but their state changes matter for later inputs and should be included or explicitly noted as gaps.
attrib.c:exercise and message operations must follow C order; preserve the ALL_SPELLS flag and blessed distinction.

evidence: Saved challenges/evaluations/20260927191056-v9.json at 5b4486322ffa5eeb91cc37d01083ff20bbfe2ea7 measures 23/24 screens and 3133/3145 RNG calls; first mismatch is C rnd(3)=1 at forget(read.c:1031) on segment 0 step 22.

Upstream nethack-c/upstream/src/read.c lines 1020-1043 and 1830-1847 define forget and seffect_amnesia; js/read.js SCR_AMNESIA dispatch at line 1837 records note_unported instead of executing the effect.
Current JS tree has no losespells or drain_weapon_skill implementation, so completion must account for these source state changes rather than merely matching the first message.
